notes: 25 candidates: 4 program-list, 0 single-record, 21 not-a-list. The three Lancaster University Management School job market pages (2015-16, 2017-18, 2018-19 cohorts) list candidates across all LUMS departments including Management Science; they give names, and the 2015-16 page thesis titles and supervisors, but no placements. The Loughborough repository Business_Theses capture shows only the first ten of a paginated collection and does not label degree level per thesis; degree level must be checked on the individual records. The LSE Government and International Relations job market pages are genuine PhD candidate lists but for political science departments, so they are marked not-a-list under the brief's department rule; the MIT page is a single Biological Engineering alumni profile, marked not-a-list for the same reason. All seven uni.lu pages belong to University of Luxembourg units outside the Luxembourg Centre for Logistics and Supply Chain Management (digital history, migration studies, computer security, doctoral school testimonials, faculty news, site navigation); none concerns the centre. No institution reassignments.
